services.name: Half Day Trip
services.desc: Hop on the New Del Mar for a great day on the water! 4.5 Hours Trips leave daily at 7:30AM and 12:30PM For groups larger than 6 people, please contact our office at (310) 372-3712 About The Trip The New Del Mar can accommodate up to 90 anglers, and has a full service galley with ice cold beer and one of the best cheeseburgers you will find on the pacific waters. The boat has a wide, roomy deck for anglers to freely move about and concentrate on fishing. All of the Marina del Rey Sportfishing vessels are Coast Guard certified and staffed with knowledgeable and experienced crew members A Great Day on the Water! • 4.5 Hours • All Ages

services.name: 3/4 Day Freelance Trip
services.desc: Fish for whatever's in season! 8.5 Hours Trips leave daily at 6:30am from Marina Del Rey Important Info We reserve the right substitute boats on any trip Tackle Rental (rod, reel, etc.): $10.00 cash, sold onboard A valid fishing license is required for anyone OVER the age of 15. All boats carry CA One-Day Fishing Licenses aboard. We will help set up and print your license onboard. Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, ice chests, coolers, firearms and explosives may not be brought onboard About The Trip The Spitfire is a fast, modern, roomy fishing vessel with state of the art A Great Day on the Water! • 8.5 Hours • All Ages
